faq.title: What you may want to know first.

items.question: What is a web app?
items.answer: A web app, also called a web application, is an application you use in the browser without installing anything, for example a booking calendar or time tracking. It runs on smartphone, tablet and desktop.

items.question: Web app or standard software: which pays off?
items.answer: When your workflows differ from the standard, several programs do not work together, or you pay for features you do not use. We look at what makes sense for you together.

items.question: Can a web app be integrated into my existing website?
items.answer: In many cases yes: as a separate area or an embedded function. What fits technically we clarify after a look at your website.

items.question: Can you also build a booking system or CRM software?
items.answer: Yes. Online booking, customer management (CRM), time tracking, orders and reporting are among the most common building blocks. We define the scope together.

items.question: How much does it cost to have a web app developed?
items.answer: It depends on features, roles and scope, so we do not give a flat price. After a conversation you receive a personal quote.

items.question: How long does it take to develop a web app?
items.answer: That depends on the scope. We can give an estimate after the first conversation, once it is clear what the application should do.

items.question: What about data protection?
items.answer: As soon as personal data is processed, GDPR matters. We discuss upfront which data is involved and where it is stored. This does not replace legal review.

items.question: How do I get started?
items.answer: Tell us via the contact form what you want to solve. We will get back to you and discuss the next step.

problems.title: Four everyday problems that have a solution.
problems.description: These are typical situations from salons, workshops and small businesses. Which solution fits depends on your workflows.

items.problem: Customers phone you just to book an appointment.
items.solution: Online booking: your customers choose free times themselves and you see all appointments in one calendar.

items.problem: Working hours are noted by hand and data gets lost.
items.solution: Your own time tracking with an admin area: shift start, shift end and hours in one place.

items.problem: Enquiries, customers, invoices and appointments sit in different spreadsheets and programs.
items.solution: One central system built around your company's workflows instead of many separate tools.

items.problem: You cannot see how orders, revenue and workload are developing.
items.solution: A dashboard with key figures, reports and analytics you understand at a glance.

problems.note: These are not guarantees but typical friction losses that suitable software can noticeably reduce.

why.title: Your business should not have to adapt to the software.
why.description: Standard software is often the right choice for simple needs, and we will tell you honestly when it is enough. A custom solution pays off when your workflows differ from the standard.
